_README: SYNTHETIC DEMO FIXTURE -- NOT REAL REPORTING. snippets.text: Chase was a full participant in Thursday's practice with no injury designation. He has drawn double-digit targets in four straight games and remains the clear focal point of the Cincinnati passing attack.
Higgins is listed as questionable with a hamstring issue and was limited in practice all week. Coaching staff indicated a game-time decision; a reduced snap count is expected even if he suits up.

Jefferson carries no injury designation into a divisional matchup with playoff seeding on the line. Minnesota is expected to lean on the passing game against a defense that has struggled against outside receivers.

Evans is fully healthy and has scored in three consecutive games. Tampa Bay has a defined role for him in the red zone.
Thomas remains the Jacksonville target leader with no injury designation, though the quarterback situation adds week-to-week variance to his projection.
Nabers cleared the concussion protocol and is expected to play a normal complement of snaps. His target share has been among the highest in the league since returning.
Jeudy has seen elevated volume with Cleveland trailing in most game scripts. No injury designation this week.
Gibbs is healthy and has handled a season-high snap share over the last three weeks as Detroit's backfield workload has consolidated.
Robinson carries no injury designation and continues to see three-down usage including passing situations.
Jacobs is questionable with an ankle sprain suffered late last week. He was limited in two of three practices and Green Bay has a capable backup ready for a larger role.
Taylor is off the injury report after a full week of practice and should return to a bell-cow workload.
With Baltimore's playoff seeding already decided, the coaching staff declined to commit to a full workload for Henry. Snap-count risk is elevated this week.

Irving has out-snapped the veteran back in each of the last four games and carries no injury designation.
Jackson is healthy but Baltimore has not ruled out limiting starters with seeding secured. Treat the projection as carrying more downside than usual.
Daniels carries no designation and Washington still has something to play for. His rushing floor has been the most consistent part of his production.
Burrow is fully healthy and Cincinnati needs a win to stay alive, pointing to a full workload and a pass-heavy script.

Nix is off the injury report. Denver faces one of the league's stronger pass defenses, which caps the ceiling despite a healthy designation.
Bowers is healthy and has been the clear target leader for Las Vegas, drawing volume that is unusual for the tight end position.
McBride carries no injury designation and continues to run a route on nearly every dropback.
Andrews is questionable with an ankle issue and Baltimore may rest starters. Two independent sources of downside stack here.
